title: Optimization Update
summary: The tutorial guides you through the process of optimizing a route by selecting the first stop.
body: Step 1: On the Routes page, click on the desired route number to open the detailed view of the route. Step 2: Identify the desired first stop and then click the "Optimize Route" button. Step 3: Use the “Start” dropdown menu, choose "Custom", and type in the address of the first stop.  The address pin will generate; click on the pin to select. Step 4: Click "Optimize." Step 5: You can also select the optimization algorithm from Preferences by choosing 'Use more intuitive ordering'."
